summary.en: 12 dogs and cats in elevation, sized from a 25 cm cat to a 70 cm large-breed dog.
summary.ja: 犬と猫あわせて12点の立面。体高25cmの猫から70cmの大型犬まで。

description.en:
Twelve companion animals for residential elevations, park and streetscape drawings: dogs standing, walking and sitting across small, medium and large breeds, and cats standing, sitting and curled up.

Shoulder heights run from 250 mm for a cat to 700 mm for a large-breed dog, so the animals sit correctly against the people and furniture in our other sets. Drawn with the same line weights as People — Elevation Vol.01, which means the two sets can be mixed in one elevation without adjustment. Includes DWG, DXF, layered AI and transparent PNGs.
description.ja:
住宅の立面図、公園や街並みの図面のための動物12点。小型・中型・大型それぞれの犬を立位・歩行・座位で、猫を立位・座位・丸まった姿勢で作図しています。

体高は猫の 250mm から大型犬の 700mm まで。当店の人物・家具セットと並べても大きさが正しく見えます。線の太さは「人物 立面 Vol.01」と揃えてあるので、2つのセットを同じ立面図に混ぜても調整は不要です。DWG、DXF、レイヤー付き AI、背景透過 PNG を同梱。
